description: The standard concepts that need vocabulary of their own (docs/foundation.md, Part II). Derived terms such as pure, abstract and top Domain are formulas, not Entities. Extends Kernel, Contexts and Operations.

axioms.about: An Action's primary Parameter is one of its own
axioms.formula: all i in Interaction, p in i.primary. p in i.parameters

axioms.about: A comparison is an Interaction of its Entity's Language
axioms.formula: all e in Entity, c in e.comparison. c.language == e.language

axioms.about: A deferral names exactly one item
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred. (some d.entity and no d.relationship and no d.interaction) or (some d.relationship and no d.entity and no d.interaction) or (some d.interaction and no d.entity and no d.relationship)

axioms.about: A deferred Entity is in the source Language
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred, x in d.entity. x.language == d.transformation.source

axioms.about: A deferred Relationship is in the source Language
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred, x in d.relationship. x.language == d.transformation.source

axioms.about: A deferred Interaction is in the source Language
axioms.formula: all d in Deferred, x in d.interaction. x.language == d.transformation.source
